info.name: Spring Boot Actuator Beans Health API

items.docs: Returns the health status of the application and all registered health indicators (database, disk space, Redis, Kafka, etc.). The response detail level is controlled by the management.endpoint.health.show-details configuration property.

params.name: component
params.description: Health indicator component name (e.g., db, diskSpace, redis)

items.docs: Returns health details for a specific health indicator component.
